parse_notes: Closed local observations on frozen synthetic benches. No generated answer, prompt, answer key, weight or machine log is published; no role is adopted.

AesCode-32B (Microsoft), GGUF Q4_K_M (bartowski, third-party conversion), on the NVLink pair with -ts 31,33: all 64 layers (and the output layer) on GPU, 16,384-token context, one llama.cpp slot, so the eight requests of the house protocol are served one after another. Engine llama.cpp b11176, the image of the night's other arms, no reasoning flag.
A vision-language model (its card: image-text-to-text, fine-tuned from Qwen/Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct) served text-only: the vision projector (mmproj) was not loaded, and every prompt here is text.
tuteur/v1 and code/v1 answers were collected on the same launch; they are not graded in this record (the same-judge grading of the published tables has not been run for them).

Not in the night's predeclared run plan: a model picked during the night, when the owner left the choice of new models to test free until 07:00 Swiss time; its weights were downloaded at a fixed revision and checked by SHA-256, and its arms were written and its fit searched before they ran.
